title: Fare statistics
statementMd:
Show the number of bookings, total fare and average fare (rounded to 2 decimals).

Expected columns: `bookings`, `total_fare`, `avg_fare`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookings, ROUND(SUM(fare), 2) AS total_fare, ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) AS avg_fare FROM bookings;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
